direction: O índice de documentos — a linha é o documento, não a marca
prompt: A flat desktop WEBSITE DESIGN MOCKUP — a screenshot of a web page layout, not a photograph, not a poster, not a scene. 16:9 desktop viewport. ENTIRE PAGE IS ACHROMATIC: off-white paper background #F5F3F0, near-black ink #17171A, 1px hairline rules in warm grey #C9C6C0. No colour anywhere, no rounded corners, no shadows, no gradients, no filled buttons, and ABSOLUTELY NO PHOTOGRAPHS OR IMAGES anywhere on this page — it is pure typography and hairlines. A clean Swiss grotesque for headlines, tiny monospace caps with wide letter-spacing for labels and file data. Header band 72px tall with the wordmark BELMARE above a small hatched stripe, centre navigation in mono caps QUEM SOMOS REPRESENTADAS CATÁLOGOS ARQUIVOS 3D, and WHATSAPP at the right, closed by a hairline. LAYOUT: the page body is split into two columns by a single FULL-HEIGHT VERTICAL HAIRLINE. LEFT COLUMN, 34% wide: a tiny mono caps label CATÁLOGOS at the top, then a 40px grotesque headline set over two lines reading 'Medida, acabamento e ficha cotada.', then a short grey paragraph of about 45 characters per line, and lower down in the same column a mono caps action line with a thin horizontal arrow beside it. RIGHT COLUMN, 66% wide: the document list fills the column edge to edge — a hairline across its top, a row of tiny mono caps column labels DOCUMENTO / ARQUIVO, then four list rows each separated by a hairline. Every row carries a 22px grotesque document title with a thin underline, a mono caps brand name set small beneath the title, mono file data aligned right (the first row reads PDF · 24,0 MB · 2025, the others read ENVIO PELA BELMARE), and a thin horizontal arrow at the row's far right edge. Below both columns, spanning the full width, one action line bounded above and below by ink-black hairlines with a 28px grotesque label at its left and a thin arrow at its right. Footer in four columns of mono caps text.
carry_forward: The full-height vertical hairline splitting argument from list — it is what keeps the list from reading as a fourth enumeration of the same four brands.
The brand set in small mono BENEATH the document title, never as its own column: that is what makes the document the subject and the brand its attribution.
File data aligned to the right of the row, arrow at the far edge.
Explicit mono column header opening the list (carried over from comp A, approved 30/07/2026).
Left column carrying the label, headline, expectation paragraph, and secondary outbound links at its foot.
notes_not_to_literalize: Every string of data in the comp is noise: document names, 'BELMARE' as the brand of every row, the São Paulo address, the phone number, the e-mail. All facts come from src/lib/representadas.ts and src/lib/site.ts.
The closing action renders in grotesque CAPS ('SOLICITE SUA FICHA COTADA AGORA.'). The system applies versal only to mono labels and short codes — the fecho is sentence case.
'ENVIO PELA BELMARE' renders as mono caps. A phrase in mono versal is banned; the state line goes in support grotesque, lower case.
'VISUALIZAR TODOS' in the left column duplicates the fecho. The left column's foot carries the outbound links (3D, brand page), not a second WhatsApp action.
The arrow spanning the full page width inside the fecho is a comp flourish; the fecho arrow is the system's 32×12 glyph.
The comp shows four rows because four is what it was told to draw. The list is N documents, and today three brands declare one document each.
